raw_text: An AI-generated video mimicking a Doordarshan news broadcast that announced fabricated emergency curfew orders for multiple Indian cities has been debunked. The clip, which went viral on social media, used a synthetic AI-generated news anchor with DD News branding. Doordarshan and PIB confirmed no such broadcast was ever aired. Experts said the video represents a growing threat of AI-generated fake news broadcasts designed to cause public panic.
clean_text: AI-generated video mimicking DD News broadcast announcing fake curfew orders debunked. Synthetic anchor with DD News branding confirmed fabricated by Doordarshan and PIB.
